core_obligations: Compare the diagonals: the diagonal of the base-changed morphism is the base change of the original diagonal along the given surjective flat finitely presented morphism (proof lines 3070-3074)
Descend surjectivity: the covering criterion gives surjectivity of the original diagonal from surjectivity of the base-changed one (proof lines 3075-3077)
Conclude: by the characterization of universal injectivity through the diagonal, the morphism is universally injective (proof lines 3078-3079)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that universal injectivity of a morphism of algebraic stacks is detected after a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 3061-3068, label lemma-check-universally-injective-covering). The proof (source lines 3070-3079) observes that the diagonal of the base change is a base change of the original diagonal, descends surjectivity along the cover and applies the characterization of universal injectivity through the diagonal (proof lines 3070-3079). The comparison of the diagonals and the descent step are the substance. H2.
